items.headline: SanDisk (SNDK) soars ~14% as investors pile back into AI‑driven memory stocks on bullish outlook for NAND pricing
SanDisk (SNDK) Q3 FY2026 results: EPS $23.41 and revenue $5.95B, both substantially above consensus; Q4 FY2026 guidance raised to $7.75B–$8.25B revenue and $30–$33 EPS
SanDisk (SNDK) shares jump over 19% after locking in multi‑year AI data center NAND supply contracts with hyperscale customers through 2028
Citi lifts SanDisk (SNDK) price target to $2,500 on exceptionally favorable AI‑driven NAND supply‑demand outlook
